implementation.rawBindFit: Longitudinal spans follow native spine distances. Reference * inverse(raw joint) preserves pelvis/chest twist. Pelvis cross section follows source/authored hip-span ratio; upper chest width/depth are unchanged. This is an explicit authored cuboid fit, not native weighted mesh import.

middleCubePartition.result: Lower and upper half have exactly the original combined pre-fit volume; north/south/east/west UV rectangles partition at the same midpoint. Internal cap faces reuse existing material. No gap-covering cube was added.

implementation.rendererAndContact: Both load goliath_mc.geo.json and encounter_goliath_source.json. No separate receiving-only enlargement or pose clamp. weak_0/weak_1 and all old non-torso regions retain their identities.

pendingJavaTests.expectedRuns: All authored torso receiving boxes against source-world corners at 3 yaws; every source frame checks all five body joins; broken weak plates preserve torso regions.

previews.method: Same numerical Gecko/cube transforms, fixed camera and scale, original atlas face-average colors. Waist sheet deliberately hides arms for diagnosis. This is not a screenshot or final material/lighting acceptance.

limits: Original giant-fist support-plane/controller gap remains; this does not lift any source joint or body root.
Existing foot/shin/weak-plate attachment concerns are outside this abdomen connection change and were not silently retuned.
